entities.summary: Mirza Adigozal bey was an Azerbaijani historian of the 19th century, best known as the author of Garabaghname. He received his early education at a maktab in Shusha. From the beginning of the 19th century, he served in the governmental and military-administrative service of Russia and held the rank of captain in the Imperial Russian Army.
